text:
Type: drop-leaf coffee table with drawer
Use: holding drinks, books and remotes, storing small things; living room, family room, small apartment
Style: farmhouse, traditional, rustic
Materials: solid pine top and folding leaves with a clear finish, black stained frame
Colors: light warm pine, black
Shape: rectangular top with two rounded drop leaves, front drawer with a black knob, open lower shelf, square legs, compact when folded, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, homey, versatile, warm
Goes with: cream or grey sofas, natural wood, black accents; farmhouse, cottage or traditional living rooms
